mechanism: Additive CNS depression from carisoprodol combined with bupropion's lowering of seizure threshold, plus CYP3A4/2D6 inhibition by bupropion may increase carisoprodol metabolite (meprobamate) levels.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and seizure risk; counsel on avoiding alcohol and tasks requiring alertness; consider alternative muscle relaxant if feasible.
